description: REAL-TIME CLOB orderbook for one Polymarket market — bid/ask ladder on both YES and NO sides with size at each price level. Use to check actual tradable depth before quoting a size estimate; the `liquidity` field on polymarket_market is a rolled-up summary, this is the actual ladder. Returns yes_bids[], yes_asks[], no_bids[], no_asks[] each as [price, size] pairs sorted from inside the book outward. Necessary input before any "you could buy $X at price Y" answer — without depth that's a guess.
name: polymarket_orderbook
